name: Illustrious Art & Styles
author: various
description: Illustrious SDXL checkpoints with a look of their own, which came from the Illustrious Anime pack when it was split on 2026-11-09. UnrealVision: a high-end 3D-render look (Unreal Engine, Arcane and Pixar-style light). RIN Flanime: flat colour with sharp line art, closer to a clean drawing. One Obsession v24: muted, cinematic colour and hazy light. Rule of Moon, PerfectDeliberate and SmoothMix Ultimate: anime pushed toward semi-real. Prompt with Danbooru tags. For plain anime use Illustrious Anime; for photoreal people use Illustrious Realism.

presets.name: One Obsession v24 (Illustrious)
presets.description:
Detailed Illustrious anime with muted, cinematic colour and hazy light. It suits atmosphere and dramatic scenes more than bright, candy colours.

The author says it works well without LoRAs or complicated tags, and warns that a newer version is not always better for your taste.

Use Danbooru tags. The card adds masterpiece, best quality, amazing quality, newest, very aesthetic, highres to the start of your prompt, so you don't need to type them.

This card uses the author's Euler Ancestral at 24 steps and CFG 4.5. The author's sample pictures add a hi-res pass up to 1536x2304, which this card does not run.

Licence: Civitai allows image use and merges, with credit to the author. Please credit maxfeifei8 when you share what you make.

presets.name: RIN Flanime Illustrious v5.0
presets.description:
Flat colour with sharp line art, closer to a clean drawing than a painting. The lines stay fine even in busy backgrounds.

The author says v5 adds better light and shadow, richer backgrounds, more saturated colour and better attention to small prompt details.

Use Danbooru tags. The card adds masterpiece, best quality, flat color to the start of your prompt, so you don't need to type them. On two-person pictures, hair colours can swap or merge, so check them.

This card uses DPM++ 2M at 25 steps and CFG 6, as in the author's samples. CFG works from 3 to 7 and Steps from 20 to 40. The author recommends a 1.5x hi-res pass, which this card does not run.

Licence: Civitai allows image use and merges with no credit required. The author asks that the model is not re-uploaded to other sites.
